title: A Sharper Ski Day
summary: Your whole day on the mountain, counted. Your wait reports, marked for everyone to see. Metric everywhere, and any mountain by its town. PeakWait 1.3.
intro: Your day on the mountain, counted the way you remember it. Here is what PeakWait 1.3 brings.

sections.h2: Every ride, every lift, your whole day
sections.html: Ride the chair, ski the run, repeat. The Day screen keeps the score: each lift you rode, your vertical, and a recap ready to share when the lifts stop turning.
Standing in a wait? Tap it. Your report stays marked on that lift for 45 minutes, and once a second skier confirms it, everyone sees it. That is how the waits get on the map: skiers like you.
Kilometers and meters on every screen, from your season stats to the leaderboards, if that is how you ski.
Type Bariloche and get Cerro Catedral. Type Squaw and get Palisades Tahoe.
